scenarios.name: fan activates when humidity exceeds threshold
fan stays on after humidity drops (off-delay)
fan off when humidity never exceeded threshold

cases.utterance: A GreaterEqual block 'Feuchte hoch' already exists with threshold set to 70. Wire the Raumfeuchtigkeit Bad sensor output to its Input1. Then add an OffDelay timer (5 minutes) on the output and connect it to the Lichtsteuerung [Bad] I1 input to keep the fan running after humidity drops.

A Not block 'Nacht' already exists. Wire the Helligkeit sensor output to its input (so Nacht=1 when dark). Then connect the Not output to the Gartenbeleuchtung I1 input so the garden light turns on at night.

scenarios.name: blinds close when windy AND sunny
blinds do NOT close when only windy

cases.utterance: An And block 'Wind und Sonne' exists with I1 already wired to Windgeschwindigkeit. Wire I2 to Sonnenschein. Then connect the And output to Jalousie 1 [Wohnzimmer] InputTriggerDown so the blinds close when it's both windy and sunny.

scenarios.name: blinds stay when no bad weather

cases.utterance: An Or block 'Wetter schlecht' exists with I1 wired to Regen. Wire I2 to a new GreaterEqual block that triggers when Windgeschwindigkeit exceeds 60 km/h. Connect the Or output to Jalousie 1 [Küche] InputTriggerUp for weather protection.

scenarios.name: light off when no presence for long time

cases.utterance: A Monoflop 'Flur Timeout' exists with Time=120. The Bewegungsmelder [Flur] is already wired to its InputTrigger. Wire the Monoflop Q output to Lichtsteuerung [Flur] I1 so the hallway light turns on for 2 minutes on motion.

The Schlafzimmer has Jalousie 1 and Fensterkontakt. Add window protection logic: when the window is open (Fensterkontakt Schlafzimmer = 1), disable the blinds. Use the Fensterkontakt output wired to Jalousie 1 [Schlafzimmer] InputDisable.

scenarios.name: fan off when humidity low (after delay)

cases.utterance: The Bad has Raumfeuchtigkeit Bad and a Lichtsteuerung. Add full humidity control: a GreaterEqual threshold at 65%, then a 10-minute OffDelay, connected to Lichtsteuerung [Bad] I2. The sensor AQ goes to the threshold Input1.

The Garage has no frost protection. Add a GreaterEqual block (inverted: triggers when Außentemperatur drops below 3°C) and connect its output to an Or block. Wire the Or to Lichtsteuerung [Garage] I1 as a frost warning indicator.

The Küche has Raumfeuchtigkeit Küche but no ventilation logic. Add a threshold (GreaterEqual at 60%) and a Monoflop (15 minutes) to Lichtsteuerung [Küche] I1. Sensor AQ → threshold Input1 → Monoflop trigger → light I1.

scenarios.name: blinds close when hot and sunny
blinds stay open when sunny but cool
blinds stay open when hot but cloudy

cases.utterance: The Wohnzimmer has Jalousie 1 but no sun automation. Add a GreaterEqual block for Außentemperatur > 25°C and an And block combining it with Sonnenschein. Wire: Außentemperatur → GreaterEqual Input1, Sonnenschein → And I1, GreaterEqual Q → And I2, And Q → Jalousie 1 [Wohnzimmer] InputTriggerDown.
The Wohnzimmer Raumregler (HeatIRoomController2) exists but has no temperature input. Wire the Raumtemperatur Wohnzimmer sensor AQ output to the Raumregler Temp input.
The Flur Lichtsteuerung exists but has no presence input. Wire the Bewegungsmelder [Flur] OutputPresence to the Lichtsteuerung [Flur] Move input for automatic motion lighting.
The Wohnzimmer Raumregler has no window contact. Wire the Fensterkontakt Wohnzimmer AQ output to the Raumregler Window input so heating pauses when the window is open.

The Gartenbeleuchtung exists and so does the Bewegungsmelder Garten. Add a StairwayLS between them: wire Bewegungsmelder Garten OutputPresence → StairwayLS InputTrigger, then StairwayLS Q → Gartenbeleuchtung I1. Set TimeHigh to 300 seconds.

scenarios.name: blinds close when sunny and hot
blinds stay when sunny but cool

cases.utterance: A GreaterEqual 'Sonne Trigger' exists and is wired to Jalousie 1 [Wohnzimmer] InputTriggerDown via Sonnenschein. Add a temperature guard: create a GreaterEqual for Außentemperatur > 25°C, then an And block. Rewire so Sonnenschein → And I1, new GreaterEqual Q → And I2, And Q → Jalousie InputTriggerDown. The blinds should only close when it's sunny AND hot.

scenarios.name: light stays on after presence ends (timeout period)

cases.utterance: The Gartenbeleuchtung currently receives a direct signal from Bewegungsmelder Garten OutputPresence to its I1 input — but it has no timeout, staying on only while presence is active. Add a StairwayLS (10 minutes) between them: rewire so presence → StairwayLS InputTrigger → Gartenbeleuchtung I1.

scenarios.name: AC activates when warm outside and triggered

cases.utterance: The Klimaanlage [Wohnzimmer] has inTempCurr wired to Raumtemperatur Wohnzimmer but no outdoor temperature guard. Add a GreaterEqual (Außentemperatur > 20°C) and wire its output to an And block. Wire And I1 from the existing AC on signal and And I2 from GreaterEqual Q. Connect And Q to Klimaanlage.on input so AC only starts when it's warm outside.

scenarios.name: blinds stay when wind is calm

cases.utterance: Jalousie 2 [Flur] has InputTriggerDown wired to Sonnenschein for automatic shading. Add wind safety: create a GreaterEqual for Windgeschwindigkeit > 50, wire it to Jalousie 2 [Flur] InputTriggerUp so high wind retracts the blinds regardless of sun.

Set up comfort/eco setpoint switching for the Wohnzimmer: use an AnalogMultiplexer to select 22°C when the room is occupied and 18°C when empty, and wire the output to the Raumregler setpoint input; wire the setpoint output to Raumregler.Input

Build a 3-mode occupancy setpoint selector for the Wohnzimmer Raumregler: AnalogMultiplexer with comfort=22°C, eco=18°C, off=15°C. Wire a NotEqual block to detect when the mode is not 'off', and feed the multiplexer output to the IRC setpoint; wire the setpoint output to Raumregler.Input and the mode indicator to Statusblock

Add a 2-minute window-close delay before re-enabling heating: when Fensterkontakt Wohnzimmer goes low, start an OnDelay, and only clear Raumregler.Window after 2 minutes so the heating doesn't cycle rapidly

Combine the Wohnzimmer window and door contacts into a single heating inhibit signal: wire both Fensterkontakt Wohnzimmer and Türkontakt Wohnzimmer through an Or gate, then into a Memory block to latch the 'window open' state, and connect Memory.Q to Raumregler.Window; wire the combined window signal to Raumregler.Window; wire the combined contact output to Raumregler.Window

scenarios.name: window close holds inhibit via off-delay

cases.utterance: When the Wohnzimmer Fensterkontakt goes from open to closed, use an OffDelay of 2 minutes to keep the Raumregler.Window inhibit active a bit longer, preventing rapid heating cycling after closing the window

Configure the Bad as a heating zone: add a Raumregler (IRC), wire Raumtemperatur Bad to the Temp input, Raumfeuchtigkeit Bad to InHumid, and Fensterkontakt Bad to the Window inhibit input; wire the heat demand output to Heizkörper Bad

Add an AnalogMultiplexer for bathroom IRC mode selection: Input1=comfort (22°C), Input2=eco (20°C). Wire the output to Raumregler Bad.AMode to switch the IRC operating mode based on room occupancy; wire the mode setpoint output to Statusblock

scenarios.name: cold outdoor temp routes to AC sensor
warm outdoor temp routes to AC sensor

cases.utterance: Set up the central heating/cooling mode switch: wire the Außentemperatur sensor to the Klimaanlage to determine whether the building should be in heating or cooling mode based on outdoor temperature

Switch between heating and cooling mode based on outdoor temperature: use a GreaterEqual threshold at 20°C on the Außentemperatur, wire to the Klimaanlage enable input so cooling only activates when it's warm outside; wire the outdoor threshold to Klimaanlage.on

Build a heating status display with a 4-input State block in the Wohnzimmer: I1=heating demand from Raumregler.AQh, I2=cooling demand from Raumregler.AQc, I3=window open from Fensterkontakt Wohnzimmer, I4=door open from Türkontakt Wohnzimmer; wire the heating status to Formel

Add AnalogScaler blocks for the Wohnzimmer IRC valve outputs: wire Raumregler.AQh through an AnalogScaler 'Heizen' (0-100%) and Raumregler.AQc through another AnalogScaler 'Kühlen' (0-100%), then feed both scaler outputs into a State block I3 and I4 to display valve positions; wire the heating scaler to Heizkörper Bad and cooling scaler to Lüfter Bad

Create an IRC cascade: wire the Außentemperatur sensor to the Wohnzimmer Raumregler.TempO for weather compensation, the Raumtemperatur Wohnzimmer to .Temp for room feedback, and the Raumfeuchtigkeit Wohnzimmer to .InHumid for humidity monitoring

Add a StateV block 'HCm Zimmer' to show the Wohnzimmer IRC setpoint on the room display: wire Raumregler.AQs (setpoint output) to StateV.I so guests can see the current target temperature; wire the setpoint display to Statusblock

scenarios.name: door opening triggers edge and button
window open shows in status I1

cases.utterance: Build a door state display: wire Fensterkontakt Wohnzimmer to State 'Status Türe'.I1 and add an EdgeDetection on Türkontakt Wohnzimmer so the rising edge triggers an AC flex button via PushButton, with the button output going to State.I2 for combined display; wire the door status to Formel; wire the EdgeDetection rising-edge output to Lichtsteuerung [Wohnzimmer]

scenarios.name: heating active shows in state and scaler
cooling active shows in state and scaler

cases.utterance: Build the complete HVAC status chain for Wohnzimmer: wire Raumregler.AQh and .AQc through AnalogScaler blocks (Heizen/Kühlen), feed raw and scaled outputs into a State block 'Status Hzg' (I1=heat demand, I2=cool demand, I3=heat valve%, I4=cool valve%), then wire the State.AQ through an AnalogMultiplexer that selects between the status value and a ventilation setpoint based on a fan-on signal; wire the heating scaler to Heizkörper Bad, cooling scaler to Lüfter Bad, and HVAC status to Formel

scenarios.name: reading light toggles on button press

scenarios.name: fan on when manual switch pressed
